links: No PHP vulnerabilities in DCB's products
subpages.text: 10/23/2026 No PHP vulnerabilities in DCB's products On October 21, 2026 PHP released fixes for two critical vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, that let attackers run code on a server without logging in. Customers are asking if DCB products (mostly the XT, FT, and UT models) might contain the weakness. These are not a problem for our customers. The user interface on these products contain no PHP at all. There's nothing to patch, update, or stop using with regard to vulnerabilitie. Call us if you're still worried. 04/15/2025 XT-6615 added to DCB's Encrypted Tunnel family We are now shipping the new XT-6615 AES Encrypted Ethernet Tunnel. This unit works alongside our other XT, UT, and ET series hardware and software products. It is rugged, with a -10 to +50C temperature rating, offers four 10/100/1000 BaseT Ethernet ports, and supports 125 Mbps with up to 50 client sites in PTP or PTMP topology, along with many other features. This is a technology refresh for the XT-6602 and XT-6606 models. Read the data sheet here. 03/31/2025 FT-6615 added to DCB's FIPS Tunnel family We are now shipping the new FT-6615 FIPS Tunnel encrypter. This unit uses the FIPS certified encryption module to work alongside our other FT series hardware and software products. It is rugged, with a -10 to +50C temperature rating, offers four 10/100/1000 BaseT Ethernet ports, and supports 125 Mbps with up to 25 client sites in PTP or PTMP topology, along with many other features. This is a technology refresh for the FT-6602 and FT-6606 models. Read the data sheet here. 03/31/2025 PR-6615 With Advanced Features We are now shipping the new PR-6615 model packet repeater. It handles up to 100,000 packets/second and up to 400 destinations. It's often used in Industrial, SCADA, ROIP, streaming
